name: @projexlight/sdk-knowledge-rag
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation substrate for ProjexCloud: define a Corpus, ingest Documents with sdk-parsing, chunk + embed via the ai-gateway, retrieve top-k by hybrid (vector + BM25) for any LLM prompt. Per-corpus access control + per-tenant chunking + reproducible retrieval audit so a customer can prove which sources fed which AI answer. Foundation for PRD-management's semantic search across the spec corpus and for the cloud builder's blueprint-discovery agent.

events.name: rag.corpus.created.v1
events.description: New corpus defined for a tenant; carries access policy + chunking strategy.

events.name: rag.document.ingested.v1
events.description: Document parsed + chunked + embedded; carries chunk_count + token_count.

events.name: rag.retrieval.served.v1
events.description: Retrieval query answered; carries the chunk_ids returned so the audit trail can reconstruct what fed an AI answer.

events.name: rag.document.deleted.v1
events.description: Document removed (DSAR or admin action); all derived chunks + vectors removed.

models.description: Per-tenant knowledge collection; carries access policy (which personas can query) + chunking strategy.
Source document row: kind (md/pdf/html/text), uri, source_hash, ingested_at, last_reindexed_at.
Per-chunk row: document_id, ordinal, text, vector_ref (pgvector / Qdrant), token_count.
Per-query audit row: tenant, persona, intent, query_text, returned_chunk_ids[], scores[], served_at.

hooks.name: createCorpus
hooks.description: Register a corpus with a chunking strategy + access policy. Empty until ingestDocument is called.

hooks.name: ingestDocument
hooks.description: Parse → chunk → embed → write. Idempotent on (corpus_id, source_hash) so re-ingestion is safe.

hooks.name: retrieve
hooks.description: Hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25). Returns top-k chunks + scores + the retrieval audit row id.

hooks.name: deleteDocument
hooks.description: Remove a document + all its chunks + vectors. Emits rag.document.deleted.v1 (consumed by sdk-data-rights for DSAR fan-out).

scenarios.title: Ingest a tenant's product documentation corpus
scenarios.when_to_use: Bootstrap a support-bot or PRD-management semantic-search; tenant uploads markdown / PDF / HTML through a one-time ingest job.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Corpus row + N document rows + many chunk rows. Vectors land in pgvector / Qdrant. Re-running with the same source_hash is a no-op (idempotent).

scenarios.title: Pull top-k chunks for an LLM prompt
scenarios.when_to_use: Cloud-builder agent or support bot wants context-aware answers. Retrieve chunks → pack into the prompt → call ai-gateway.complete.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns ranked chunks + retrieval_id. Emits rag.retrieval.served.v1 with the returned chunk_ids. Downstream audit can trace 'this AI answer used chunks X/Y/Z from doc D'.

scenarios.title: Semantic search across the PRD corpus
scenarios.when_to_use: prd-management blueprint surface: 'show me every feature that references audit chain forensics.'
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns up to 10 chunks ordered by hybrid score. UI surfaces the parent feature + a snippet around the matched chunk. Audit row gives the operator full traceability.

scenarios.title: DSAR triggers document + chunk + vector deletion
scenarios.when_to_use: Subject revokes consent; sdk-consent fires the revoked event; this SDK consumes + removes every chunk derived from documents tagged with that subject.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Documents + their chunks + vectors all removed. Emits rag.document.deleted.v1 per doc. Retrieval audit rows retain the old chunk_ids for compliance — they're tombstones now, not retrievable.

scenarios.title: Operator reproduces an AI answer for compliance review
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer disputes an AI-generated answer; we need to show exactly which corpus chunks fed it, and what the prompt + completion looked like.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Operator can reconstruct: question → retrieval scores → chunks used → completion text. Sufficient for EU AI Act Annex IV logging + most regulator transparency requests.

compliance_posture.notes: Reproducible retrieval audit is the AI Act compliance lever — auditors can reconstruct any AI answer to its source chunks. Per-corpus access policy enforced before retrieval — a persona without read access on a corpus never sees its chunks even if their query would match. Right-to-erasure fan-out is synchronous: vector deletion happens before the operation returns success.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per document ingested (parsing + chunking + embedding billed end-to-end)
per retrieval query (cache hits billed at lower rate)
per GB of vector + chunk text storage per month
